text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Thursday, January 17, 2019 Posted by admin on January 17th, 2019
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -70 points.
Wednesday the Dow was up +141.57 (+0.59%) at 24,207.16.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +3.77%.
There were 14 Dow stocks up Wednesday.
The Dow stock winners Wednesday were led by Goldman Sachs (GS) +9.54%, UnitedHealth (UNH) +1.79% and American Express (AXP) +1.45%.
The Dow stock losers Wednesday were led by Verizon (VZ) -1.76%, Pfizer (PFE) -1.45% and Coca Cola (KO) -1.37%.
American Express (AXP) reports earnings after the close today.
Brent crude contracts for March delivery, the global benchmark, were marked 92 cents lower from their Wednesday close in New York and changing hands at $60.23 per barrel while WTI contracts for February were marked $1.10 lower at $51.21 per barrel.
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended lower.
The national average price of gasoline is unchanged at $2.242 per gallon.
